body:
Part of #36. Plan step **P01**. First planning discussion; no source inspection or product code in this issue.

## Outcome

Agree exactly what the owner means by monthly product profit before mapping SQL fields or changing the interface. The requested experience answers: which products sold, how much each contributed to profit, and the monthly overall profit, on one scrolling page.

**Working assumption, awaiting confirmation:** gross product profit before operating expenses. Proposed label: `Tahmini brüt kâr` when historical last-purchase costs are used. This is not net profit, cash balance or verified inventory costing. Expense features/data remain available separately; their absence must not block a gross-profit view. If the user means operating/net profit, revise this scope before implementation.

## Decisions and deliverables

- [x] Agree the metric dictionary: sold quantity, returned quantity, net quantity (units separated), net sales after discounts/returns and excluding recorded KDV, historical estimated cost, covered estimated gross profit and margin, and coverage. Decide the date/return-period convention explicitly.
- [x] Define product identity and display, unknown product/unit behavior, cost evidence, discounts/rounding and returns. Do not substitute a current purchase price for historical cost.
- [x] Define the overall figure as the sum of the same covered product contributions. With incomplete sales/cost coverage, label only the covered result and withhold an unqualified whole-market profit. Missing cost is never zero. Define empty, genuine zero, loss, partial, unsupported and stale states independently.
- [x] Agree one-page order: month and status → overall estimate/coverage → profit trend → searchable/sortable product contributions → selected product and source-line evidence. Recommended interaction: product selection changes the detail section while the monthly headline stays market-wide and explicitly labelled. Freeze filter behavior before coding.
- [x] Inventory existing report and UI modules to reuse. Capture one lightweight layout sketch and state examples, not a whole visual redesign.
- [x] Resolve the source-scope conflict explicitly: the current raw preview prohibits product-name/cost expansion. Specify a separately reviewed minimal financial projection for stable product identity, safe product display/unit and historical cost/return evidence. Any change to the preview allowlist or repository instructions requires its own explicit recorded decision. Customer/employee/supplier fields are unnecessary for this slice and stay excluded.
- [x] Record the focus change against the foundation's expense/operating-profit main surface. Keep existing functionality and saved reports; do not silently delete it or rewrite its meaning. Update the applicable specification/contracts with the agreed delta during this issue.
- [x] Produce independent synthetic examples, the versioned report/interface delta, exact Turkish labels and a bounded implementation checklist for P03–P05. Mark those issues executable only after this review; unresolved real semantics still gate real activation.

## Existing material

[docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-04-esmer-market-rebuild-design.md](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/6d717bef53f3a7fcf23bb9845e809ae9c79603a3/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-04-esmer-market-rebuild-design.md), [docs/contracts/calculations.md](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/6d717bef53f3a7fcf23bb9845e809ae9c79603a3/docs/contracts/calculations.md), [docs/contracts/source.md](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/6d717bef53f3a7fcf23bb9845e809ae9c79603a3/docs/contracts/source.md), [docs/contracts/privacy.md](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/6d717bef53f3a7fcf23bb9845e809ae9c79603a3/docs/contracts/privacy.md), [CONTEXT.md](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/6d717bef53f3a7fcf23bb9845e809ae9c79603a3/CONTEXT.md).

Inspect `src/analytics/costs.ts` (`GrossResult`), `src/reports/contracts.ts` (`MonthlyReport`, `SalesView`), `src/reports/display.ts` and `src/ui/overview/MonthlyOverview.tsx`. Extend the existing design only where the owner flow requires it.

## Exit gate

A reviewed profit definition, source-scope decision, metric/state matrix and one-page composition sketch exist with no ambiguity about gross versus operating profit or covered versus total profit. Documentation diff and links pass. No database access, application implementation or release acceptance is claimed.

## Execution and evidence

This is a planning backlog, not an instruction to start implementation. First settle the named decisions in P01 with the user. For each behavioral change, expose the missing contract with a focused failing test, record the actual failure, make the smallest implementation change, and run the relevant checks. Reuse the existing Vitest, Playwright packaged-desktop and synthetic SQL harness; do not create a new orchestration framework.

Use coherent Conventional Commits (`test:`, `feat:`/`fix:`, then evidence as needed). Record the task/gate, commit/build, opaque fixture/source batch, environment, command/procedure, expected and actual result, evidence location and remaining limits. Synthetic success is not source validation; macOS success is not Windows acceptance. Preserve unrelated work and accepted reports. Source access and production rollout retain their separate authorization boundaries.

## P01 reviewed outcome · 2026-09-29

The user approved estimated gross product profit before operating expenses, return-month attribution, and the complete contract and diagram. The user then confirmed the app will include at most three graphs; the sketch shows daily covered profit, product covered profit and cost coverage. The contract defines market-wide headline/trend scope, table-only search/sort, explicit coverage/states, safe product identity/display, preserved expense/report paths and a separate reviewed financial projection. The raw preview allowlist is unchanged.

Documentation was merged in PR #45 as merge commit `9923427afa1716105b5ced224783bfa6189cccfe`, preserving planning commit `307e30632e15cf586746415994aa5908e0edea30` and graph clarification commit `f50890365aa37ed448af33fcb957b78b0702ee35`. [Contract](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/main/docs/contracts/monthly-product-profit.md), [diagram/page sketch](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/main/docs/diagrams/monthly-product-profit.html), and [verification](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/main/docs/evidence/issue-38-planning.md).

Independent decimal expectations, 36 local links/anchors, whitespace and accessible-diagram checks passed. The sketch was rendered and inspected in Chrome. Independent review has no outstanding findings. No database access, application changes, Windows acceptance or release acceptance occurred.

P01 planning is complete. P04 synthetic groundwork has its P01 prerequisite satisfied for separate execution direction; P05 still needs the P04 contract, and P03 still needs P02 source evidence. Real-source semantics, exact new query/column approval and renewed source authorization remain separately gated.
title: [P1] Define the monthly product-profit contract and source scope
